attempts.cause: Builder test included the platform-reserved internal event field.
attempts.resolution: Remove the reserved field from external test inputs; keep external forgery forbidden.

attempts.cause: Concurrent runs wrote the same declared artifact path.
attempts.resolution: Isolate generated artifacts by run without changing business filenames.

attempts.cause: The chosen subject already had an unrelated pending timer.
attempts.resolution: Use a fresh subject and retain the polluted attempt as invalid evidence.

attempts.cause: The deadline completed before platform shutdown.
attempts.resolution: Use a longer deadline and confirm pending status before shutdown.

attempts.cause: The first synthetic entity update had no initialized prior state.
attempts.resolution: Initialize an off baseline before the post-reconnect open event.

attempts.cause: The runtime activated both implicit success and explicit error paths.
attempts.resolution: Make the reserved error branch exclude the implicit success edge and add a regression test.

attempts.cause: The verifier read a deadline run after timer completion but before workflow completion.
attempts.resolution: Wait for the timer-associated run to reach a final state; rerun with fresh identities.
